standard.summary: LoKr 强制走 full matrix 路线
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Forces LoKr onto the full matrix route
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: LoKr 强制走 full matrix 路线，避免自动退回到分解矩阵。更吃参数和显存，只建议明确需要时启用。

advanced_en.principle: Forces LoKr down the full-matrix route, avoiding automatic fallback to the factorized matrix. Heavier in parameters and VRAM; enable only when clearly needed.
